answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Every claim climbs the echo of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the terrace re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt. What survives to the inlet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
